about.quote: Makeup is not a mask; it is the art of illuminating the royal goddess within you.
about.bioParagraph1: Welcome to the world of Arsh Khan — Delhi's acclaimed bridal makeup artist known for creating breathtaking, photogenic, and skin-like bridal transformations. Based in South Delhi (Pincode 110017) and serving the entirety of Delhi NCR and royal destination venues across India.
about.bioParagraph2: Arsh's signature technique blends modern global aesthetics with timeless Indian royal tradition. Every stroke is measured to enhance your unique facial architecture, ensuring your bridal glow remains immaculate under 4K video lights, tearful vidai moments, and late-night celebrations.

policy.title: STUDIO & BOOKING POLICIES
policy.subtitle: Please review our booking guidelines before scheduling your consultation.

items.title: 50% Advance Booking (Non-Refundable)
items.desc: A 50% non-refundable advance deposit is required to confirm and lock your wedding date in our calendar. Without an advance deposit, dates remain open to other inquiries.

items.title: 15-20 Days Prior Advance Booking
items.desc: Bridal dates during the peak wedding season fill up quickly. We strongly advise confirming your booking at least 15 to 20 days in advance to reserve your preferred artist slot.

items.title: Outstation Travel & Stay Extra
items.desc: For all destination or outstation weddings outside Delhi NCR, client arranges or reimburses round-trip travel tickets and secure hotel accommodations for the artist and assistant.

items.title: 100% Genuine Luxury Products
items.desc: We exclusively use top-tier genuine international brands: MAC, Huda Beauty, NARS, Bobbi Brown, Charlotte Tilbury, and Dior. We maintain strict hygiene and sanitize all brushes between clients.
